subject: Rivermark POC kickoff — ops checklist, prompt-suite & success metrics
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@rivermarkenergy.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@rivermarkenergy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Rivermark POC kickoff — ops checklist, prompt-suite & success metrics

Hi Alex / Priyanka —

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment overall. As promised, below is a concise recap of what we heard, the proposed POC scope, owners, and the immediate access items so your engineers can onboard to the test environment next week. If anything here is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

What we heard (pain & goal)
- Pain: Manual post-processing of field reports and occasional misclassification of equipment events. Teams spend ~8–10 engineering hours/week cleaning outputs before ingestion into the analytics pipeline.
- Goal: Reduce manual triage by at least 60% for the initial event-classification use case and surface candidate troubleshooting steps for site engineers.

Proposed POC scope (30 days)
- Ingest: 2 weeks of anonymized field report exports (~100k tokens/day sample) into a secure test bucket.
- Models & prompts: Evaluate two model variants (gpt-open-7b-quant, gpt-open-13b-int8) with a prompt-suite of 12 canonical prompts: classification, normalization, explanation, and follow-up questioning. We will provide a suggested prompt matrix and baseline evals.
- Success metrics: 1) macro F1 >= 0.75 on classification slice A, 2) average human review time reduction >= 60%, 3) median 95th perc latency < 350ms for single-turn conversions (target on Dedicated).
- Deliverables: weekly eval reports (precision/recall by label), prompt library with suggested guardrails, and a demo wrap-up with recommendations (quantization and batching profile).

Owners & timeline
- Redwood: Laura (eng sponsor / PM lead), Marissa (solutions / evals), Sean (infra & ops).
- Rivermark: Alex (product owner), Priyanka (data & security), Eng team (engineering lead for access).
- Timeline: access & test data by Feb 3, initial eval run by Feb 10, iterative tuning week of Feb 15, demo & decision meeting Feb 26.

Immediate access/setup asks (action items)
1) Create a read-only S3-compatible test bucket and grant these service principals: redwood-poc@redwood.ai and marissa.cole@redwood.ai.
2) Share a sample of 2k records with the anonymization mapping.
3) Provide a technical contact and jump host IP range for initial connectivity.

Attachments: rivermark_poc_scope_v1.pdf (scope doc) and rivermark_access_checklist.csv (columns: item, owner, done).

Next steps
- Alex/Priyanka: confirm owners and the two data-sharing items above by end of Tue (Feb 2).
- Redwood: we’ll upload the prompt-suite draft and a lightweight eval harness to the shared Drive link after we get access.

Thanks — excited to get started.

—
Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@rivermarkenergy.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@rivermarkenergy.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Rivermark POC kickoff — ops checklist, prompt-suite & success metrics

Laura — thanks for the clear recap. This matches what we took away. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data: we can provide the 2k anonymized records by EOD Monday (Feb 1). We will strip PII and replace device IDs with synthetic tokens — our security team will attach a short anonymization spec.
2) Metrics: the 60% reduction target is acceptable as an internal success threshold. For the demo, we also want to see error rate by severity (Critical, High, Low) so we can assess operational risk.
3) Latency: 350ms median 95th perc is aggressive but acceptable for the POC if we run the smaller model on Dedicated. Please include a fallback to hosted variant if Dedicated contention impacts the demo window.

On owners: Alex will be our PO but I’ll coordinate the data share. Eng contact is eng@rivermarkenergy.com (SRE on rotation is Marcus Lee).

We’ll confirm the bucket permissions once the security spec is attached.

Thanks — Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Data Platform, Rivermark Energy
prianka.shah@rivermarkenergy.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@rivermarkenergy.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@rivermarkenergy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 02:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Rivermark POC kickoff — ops checklist, prompt-suite & success metrics

Priyanka / Alex — great, thanks for the confirmations and the SRE contact. Quick operational notes and additions based on the security comment: 

- Fallback plan: we’ll configure a routed policy so the demo will automatically switch to the Redwood-hosted compatible model variant if Dedicated GPU pool is congested. That will be documented in the runbook we share.
- Severity breakdown: we’ll add error-by-severity slices to the weekly evals (Critical/High/Low) and include a small human review panel for Critical cases to estimate safety/regression risk.
- Access details we need from Rivermark IT: bucket ARN, IAM role or presigned STS tokens, and the jump host IP(s) for the initial setup. We can accept presigned objects for the sample if IAM setup takes longer.

Action items now (to avoid drift):
- Priyanka: send the anonymization spec + sample by EOD Mon (Feb 1).
- Alex: confirm PO and meeting cadence (standup frequency; weekly is fine).
- Marissa (Redwood): I’ve assigned Marissa to own the eval harness and prompt-suite delivery. Marissa — can you prepare a short README + sample eval script and drop it in the Drive link by Monday morning PST?

Attachment: rivermark_poc_scope_v1.pdf (updated minor edits).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — I’ll create the HubSpot deal task and schedule the first sync for Feb 3.

—
Laura

On Sat, Jan 30, 2027 at 08:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Rivermark POC kickoff — ops checklist, prompt-suite & success metrics

Thanks — quick internal checklist for us so nothing gets missed: 

1) Prompt-suite: compile 12 canonical prompts + edge-case variants (Marissa) — due Mon 09:00 PST.
2) Eval harness: lightweight runner + labeling schema + slice definitions (Marissa) — drop in Drive and link to HubSpot.
3) Infra: preconfigure Dedicated routing policy and quick fallback to hosted variant; add alert for latency > 500ms (Sean).
4) Onboarding: prepare short runbook for the Rivermark SRE (including presigned sample flow) and a one-page security FAQ (Laura + Sean).

I’ll prepare the README and include a sample eval script (Python) that hits our staging endpoint and writes a CSV with fields: record_id, predicted_label, probability, latency_ms, severity_tag.

I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the checklist and create the Feb 3 calendar invite (30m) for initial handoff.

—Marissa
